query: Before we build a claims assistant, define representative tasks, safe refusals, prohibited effects, and a scoring contract. Include dataset provenance and a release gate for consequential errors.
Compare two deployed support assistants on the same tickets. Separate answer correctness from unauthorized tool actions, repeat noisy tasks, and report paired quality differences with uncertainty.
Our new agent scores well overall but fails uncommon urgent requests. Design severity-weighted slices and acceptance thresholds so common easy tasks cannot hide costly regressions.

Create a gold set for an assistant that investigates invoice mismatches. Specify initial state, reset procedures, evidence expectations, partial outcomes, and what should be scored by code versus human judgment.
We use a model to grade research answers, but it favors longer responses and trusts quoted instructions. Calibrate a blinded rubric against human labels and document disagreement handling.

A planning bot reaches correct final answers after making forbidden intermediate calls. Define trajectory and outcome scores and ensure those violations fail the release decision regardless of answer quality.
Help prevent evaluation leakage when ticket paraphrases, source documents, and remembered answers appear in both tuning and test data. Propose split units and a frozen held-out evaluation procedure.
We changed retrieval and prompts together and cannot explain the agent improvement. Build matched ablations, an earliest-failure taxonomy, and quality, abstention, latency, and cost reporting.
The team calls a single successful demo an agent benchmark. Replace it with a versioned task population, repeated stochastic runs, operational constraints, and a defensible acceptance decision.

Design release checks for a booking assistant that can complete, abstain, or return partial work. Define denominators, observed safety violations, evidence-grounded scoring, and meaningful baseline comparisons.
Write deterministic tests for admission and state transitions in an agent executor. Stub model responses, inject crash windows, and assert that denied proposals never change persisted state.
Measure whether the model selects the correct search tool among similar names and passes valid IDs into dependent calls. Focus on tool usability dimensions rather than overall task-answer quality.

Create a scoring script for our retrieval stage using labeled document relevance, Recall@10, MRR, and deduplicated source identities. Generation and whole-agent release scoring are outside this request.

Our task-quality thresholds are already approved. Calculate total model and tool spend per successful run, including retries and cache charges, and compare routing changes under that fixed quality floor.
Add trace fields linking evaluator verdicts to source evidence and tool receipts across resumed agent runs. Reuse the existing rubric unchanged; the missing piece is operational instrumentation.
A checkout total is wrong when discounts are applied twice. Reproduce the defect with a failing unit test, locate its cause, implement the fix, and run the repository test suite.
Design JSON variants for a model-produced action, refusal, and insufficient evidence response. Specify semantic validation and bounded repair; we are not choosing task populations or scoring rubrics.

Build an MCP server evaluation XML with ten independent read-only questions whose stable answers require several tool calls. Follow the existing protocol tooling rather than designing an agent benchmark.

Rewrite a production classification prompt with conflicting instructions and redundant examples. Existing evaluation cases and thresholds are fixed; deliver a versioned prompt and a rollback-compatible change.
Review evidence before claiming this implementation is finished: run the build and tests, inspect exit codes, and map the approved requirements to the resulting changes and any uncovered gaps.
